title: Lofn Studio FlowSpec
description: The executable document (plan §4). Lofn's real shape is linear coordinator → one fan-out over pairs → join → run-level gates. FlowSpec v1 models exactly that, NOT a general DAG. Generated by the canon importer from pipeline_map.yaml; immutable once a run exists (copy-on-write to @N+1).

version.description: Monotonic version. Copy-on-write bumps this. @1 is the canon import.

base.description: Provenance: what this was imported/derived from. 'canon@<git-sha>' for imports, 'lofn-<modality>@<n>' for copy-on-write derivations.

knobs_defaults.description: Repo-relative (or flow-relative) path to the default knobs preset for this flow.

context.description: The CREATIVE CONTEXT injection contract. `template` is read from canon at resolve time; `slots` are the {token}s the resolver fills.

template.description: Repo-relative path to the modality OVERALL_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md (read-only at resolve time).

slots.description: CREATIVE CONTEXT slot tokens (must be a subset of pipeline_map.yaml creative_context_slots).

model_tiers.description: Role → model assignment (heritage: vault/LOFN_MODEL_ASSIGNMENTS.md + model_defaults.yaml). Steps reference a tier by name via `tier`.

stages.description: Ordered stages. A stage is either sequential (`steps`) or a fan-out (`foreach: pair`).

params.description: Optional per-tier provider params (temperature, thinking, etc.). The dialect strips unsupported params rather than erroring.

foreach.description: If present, this stage fans out. v1 supports only 'pair' (fan-out over step-05's pair assignments).

concurrency.description: Fan-out concurrency cap. May be a knob expression like '{max_concurrency}'.

id.description: Step id within the stage, e.g. '00', '11', 'distinctiveness'.

kind.description: 'llm' (default) calls a provider; 'validator' is a pure script step (no LLM call).

prompt.description: Repo-relative path to the canon step prompt file (read-only at resolve time). Null for validator-kind steps.

overlay.description: Optional repo-relative path to an overlay patch (ordered exact-match find→replace hunks, apply-or-error). Rewrites the resolved prompt in memory only.

tier.description: model_tiers key selecting the model for this step. Null for validator-kind steps.

emits.description: Canonical artifact filename this step writes (e.g. 'step00_aesthetics_genres.md', 'pair_{pair}_step08_generation.md').

consumes.description: Canonical artifact names this step reads (beyond the always-present CREATIVE CONTEXT).

run.description: For kind:validator — repo-relative path to the validator script to shell out to.

gates.description: Gate ids (from pipeline_map.yaml gates[]) whose validators guard this step's output edge.

policy.description: block = stop the run; flag = amber chip, continue; retry = re-call with repair prompt (validate_with_retries semantics); quarantine_pair = the Andon Cord.

max_attempts.description: For policy:retry — total attempts including the first (mirrors validate_with_retries --max-attempts).
